On June 18, 2025, archaeologist K. Amarnath Ramakrishna’s 12th transfer in 21 years sparked headlines. Moved from ASI’s Antiquity Director to the National Mission on Monuments and Antiquities, critics saw it as sidelining him from mainstream archaeology. The reason? Keeladi, a Tamil Nadu village unearthing an ancient Tamil civilization, fueling North vs. South, Aryan vs. Dravidian debates, and political clashes. Watch full video-
